base_member_text: [L189-L195] (HIGH/unguarded action conversion) Wave energy is divided by per-direction intrinsic frequency s%sigt with no positive-frequency guard.
audit_member_text: [L189-L195,L212-L220] (MED/numerical robustness) Wave action conversion divides wet-cell energy by sigt with no positive-frequency guard.

base_member_text: [L45-L127] (MED/saved-shape state) All saved work arrays are sized only on the first call, so reuse after a grid or direction-count change retains incompatible shapes.
audit_member_text: [L45-L129] (LOW/persistent allocation/state) Saved workspaces are never resized and mask_ee is only set true over the current interior without being reset, imposing fixed grid/decomposition bounds across the process lifetime.

base_member_text: [L378-L388, L402-L412] (HIGH/interpolation extent mismatch) Wave-crest boundary interpolation constructs nx+3 coordinate and value entries by adding two infinite endpoints but passes nx+1 as the interpolation length, silently excluding part of the constructed support.
audit_member_text: [L379-L388,L402-L412] (HIGH/interpolation contract) Wave-crest boundary interpolation constructs nx+3 point coordinate/value arrays but passes nx+1 as their length, truncating the final interior point and upper sentinel and changing the intended interpolation domain.

base_member_text: [L325-L330] (HIGH/division by zero) Roller dissipation divides by the magnitude of directional phase velocity without guarding a zero-speed wet cell.
audit_member_text: [L322-L337] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Roller dissipation divides by sqrt(cx^2+cy^2) without guarding zero propagation speed.

base_member_text: [L437-L454] (HIGH/dimensionally incorrect roller cap) After scaling directional roller energy using equivalent height RH, total roller energy s%R is capped directly against gammax*hhw (an energy-versus-length comparison) instead of being recomputed from the scaled rr or converted height.
audit_member_text: [L437-L457] (HIGH/dimensional/state consistency) After roller directional energies are rescaled, s%R is limited directly against gammax*hhw, mixing energy and height units, and is not recomputed from the scaled rr field.

base_member_text: [L140-L145, L460-L465] (HIGH/circular-angle averaging) Multi-direction mean wave angles are computed by arithmetic averaging rather than circular vector averaging, failing for spectra spanning the 0/2π boundary.
audit_member_text: [L144-L165,L460-L466] (HIGH/circular statistics) For multi-directional waves the mean angle is an arithmetic weighted average, producing incorrect directions across the angular wrap.

base_member_text: [L179-L184] (HIGH/inconsistent hyperbolic limiter) The sinh(2kh) approximation has the same discontinuous <=3000 test with an internal cap at 10 and a fixed 3000 value above the test.

[L203-L209] (MED/stale optional tendency) thetaadvec is subtracted every call but is reset only when refraction is enabled, so disabling refraction after prior enabled calls preserves an old refraction tendency.
[L281-L286, L434-L435] (MED/unguarded dry-cell arithmetic) Orbital velocity is evaluated over the full grid before any wet mask, dividing by sinh(kh) at potentially zero-depth cells.

audit_member_text: [L147-L160] (MED/numerical robustness) The Snell branch clamps the asin input but still divides by coffshore without guarding a zero offshore phase speed.
